clue.text: Impressions of one million people - about most of nation

indicators.note: most of a word means all but its final letter is kept
about means surrounding, so one piece wraps round the other

blocks.note: one is the Roman numeral I
M is the abbreviation for million
a plain synonym
taken as written, then its last letter goes

explanation.surface: Someone muses on the impressions left by a single person among millions, mostly from one country.
explanation.walkthrough: 'about' tells you the people wrap round the shortened nation, rather than the other way.
explanation.definitionFit: Impressions in the sense of a comic's take-offs of famous voices are mimicked performances.

clue.text: Meet Prince in trouble for cheek

blocks.note: the letters to rearrange, including the small word in

explanation.walkthrough: 'in trouble' reads as a single phrase, but 'in' belongs to the letters and 'trouble' alone is the signal.
explanation.definitionFit: Cheek, as in saucy rudeness toward someone owed respect, is a common British synonym.

Roman numeral one
p is piano, the musical direction for quiet

explanation.surface: A small songbird is found down a mine, like a canary kept by miners.
explanation.walkthrough: I and P go together inside PIT, after its first letter.
explanation.definitionFit: A pipit is a small brown songbird, so a little singer describes it neatly.

clue.text: Enter with writ taken round to be edited

explanation.definitionFit: An offhand manner is brusque and casual, showing curt lack of courtesy.

clue.text: Cancels, including first aid books

the opening letter of aid

explanation.walkthrough: 'first aid' reads as one phrase, but 'first' picks a letter and 'aid' supplies it.
explanation.definitionFit: Annuals are yearbooks, children's hardback books published once each year.

clue.text: State paid a home help to come in

explanation.walkthrough: A home help is a carer who visits someone's house to do chores.
explanation.definitionFit: Idaho is one of the fifty United States, in the American north-west.

clue.text: Dark horse may give you a fright in bed

definitions.text: may give you a fright in bed

blocks.note: first meaning, taken literally: a female horse of the dark hours

blocks.clueFragment: may give you a fright in bed
blocks.note: second meaning: a frightening dream

explanation.walkthrough: A dark horse is normally an unexpected contender; here it is read literally, a mare of the night.
explanation.definitionFit: A bad dream scares a sleeper, and the word splits into the darkness and a female horse.

clue.text: Fruit father wanted to start with

the opening letter of wanted

taken as written

past tense of lend
taken as written

explanation.surface: A bank keeps cutting back its lending.

a post is a position of employment

explanation.definitionFit: The apostles were the disciples sent out by Christ to spread his gospel, missionary preachers.

taken as written

clue.text: Dirtying lilo put on ground

taken as written, then rearranged

clue.text: Pompous old lady takes her medicine around one

Roman numeral one

clue.text: For example, six-footer in queue is after Rose
